340B Community Impact Report:
Famiily Medical Centers
Ironton-Lawrence County Area CAO, Inc.
Serving our Community Through the 340B Drug Pricing Program

Our Mission and Community:   Family Medical Centers, a program of Ironton-Lawrence County CAO, Inc., is committed to providing high-quality, patient-centered care to individuals and families across our service area.  We serve patients regardless of their ability to pay, focusing on those who are uninsured, underinsured, and medically underserved.
The 340B Drug Pricing Program allows our organization to stretch limited resources and expand access to essential services for our community.

What the 340B Program Means to Our Health Center:  Through the 340B program, Family Medical Centers can purchase medications at reduced prices. The savings generated are not retained as profit.  Instead, they are reinvested directly into patient care and community services to fulfill our mission and meet the needs of our patients.

How 340B Savings Support Our Patients:  
Access to Medications:  340B savings help reduce medication costs for patients, including those on a sliding fee scale, improving affordability and adherence.
Expanded Services:  Savings are reinvested to support primary care, behavioral health, dental services, and chronic disease management programs.
Addressing Barriers to Care: Funds support enabling services such as transportation assistance, care coordination, and translation services, ensuring patients can access the care they need.
Sustaining Care for Vulnerable Populations: 340B savings help offset uncompensated care and allow the health center to continue serving patients regardless of ability to pay.

Impact on Our Community:
340B savings enable Family Medical Centers to serve more patients, expand services, and improve helath outcomes in our community.  These investments allow us to deliver comprehensive, whole-person care and respond to emerging community health needs.

Why 340B Matters:
Without the 340B program, our ability to provide affordable medications and essential services would be significantly reduced.  With 340B, we are able to expand access to care, improve health outcomes, and strengthen the overall health of the community we serve.

Looking Ahead: Family Medical Centers remains committed to leveraging 340B savings to enhance services, improve patient outcomes, and address the evolving needs of our community.  We continue to invest in programs that promote health equity and access to care.
